prompt: Down the length of a Gothic English cathedral nave at night: the pews pushed aside and the stone floor covered in sleeping bags and blankets right up to the altar, hundreds of people asleep, candles and camping lanterns the only light on the pillars, breath in the cold air. Winter night in a near-future Britain, the streetlights dead, lit only by braziers, camping lanterns and the glow of the city's towers; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
